title: FloodLite: A Multi-Platform Edge-Deployment Benchmark for Lightweight Flood Segmentation -- code, ONNX exports, and per-platform benchmarks
description:
Reproducible code, pre-trained PyTorch checkpoints, ONNX FP32 / INT8 exports, and per-platform benchmarking harnesses for the manuscript:

FloodLite: A Multi-Platform Edge-Deployment Benchmark for Lightweight Flood Segmentation. Chawdhury et al., 2026. Under review at the International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction (IJDRR).

This release contains the artifacts used to produce every table and figure in the manuscript:

  • Code -- training and evaluation pipeline (code/floodlite/), benchmark scripts (code/scripts/), and figure / table generators.
  • Pre-trained PyTorch checkpoints -- teacher (UNet+EfficientNet-B0), MobileNetV2 baseline, and three lightweight UNet students (MobileNetV3-Small, EfficientNet-Lite0, MobileViT-XXS) under four KD configurations (none, resp, feat, comb), across three folds of FSSD. 42 checkpoints total.
  • ONNX exports -- FP32 and static-QDQ INT8 versions of the three deployable students.
  • Per-fold metrics in code/runs/3fold/{results,quantized,summary,stats,lat_m2,lat_wasm}.json.
  • LaTeX manuscript source under manuscript/ (elsarticle, two-column journal format).

Headline result: the EfficientNet-Lite0-UNet INT8 configuration runs at 58 FPS on a 2023 Apple M2 Pro laptop CPU and 6 FPS in a single-threaded browser WebAssembly sandbox at 3.83x size reduction with 95% IoU recovery relative to the UNet+EfficientNet-B0 teacher.

See manuscript/main.pdf for the full paper and README.md for reproduction instructions.
notes: Manuscript is under review at the International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction (IJDRR); the published-paper DOI will be added to this record as a 'isSupplementTo' related identifier once a publication DOI is issued. The MobileNetV3-Small and MobileViT-XXS INT8 ONNX exports are released for reproducibility but are NOT recommended for deployment -- they exhibit large post-training-quantization IoU drops (Delta = -0.45) under the static QDQ recipe; see Section 5.3 of the manuscript. Use the EfficientNet-Lite0 INT8 ONNX (Delta IoU = -0.043) for deployment.
